reason: The plugin is classified as data-processing because its primary function is to collect and aggregate token usage from local session logs, then present daily/weekly cost and consumption reports in the web interface and a JSON API. It is focused on usage analytics and visualization rather than automation workflows, file-editing tools, or external service orchestration.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 插件，用于按本地日期聚合会话日志中的 token 用量并在设置页展示图表和明细，同时提供 /token-stats 报告页与 /api/token-stats 接口。
summaries.en: This is a DSH web plugin that aggregates token usage from session logs by day, displays charts and usage details in the settings UI, and provides a /token-stats report page with a /api/token-stats JSON endpoint.

capabilities: reads local DSH session log files and in-memory active session state
aggregates token usage by local calendar day and by model
renders daily/weekly usage charts, KPI metrics, and detail tables in the web settings UI
serves token statistics through a local JSON endpoint for the web report
